heroSubtitle: Ghaate wali rides chhodo, kamai wali uthao. RiderSaathi aapke set kiye hue rules par Rapido, Uber aur Porter ki bookings filter karta hai — taaki aap screen taakte rehne ke bajaye sadak par dhyan rakh kar befikar kaam kar sako.
heroEnText: RiderSaathi is an independent ride filter app for bike-taxi, auto, cab and parcel drivers. Set your own rules — trip distance, pickup distance, parcel or passenger, route and fare — and RiderSaathi accepts only the bookings that match. Earn more, drive easier, keep your eyes on the road.
